summary: Resource-manager entry point that either reuses an existing resource or allocates and configures a new one. Looks up the resource by name via sub_548890; when it already exists and the a4 flag bit 0x100 is clear, bumps its reference count at +136 and returns 0. Otherwise allocates a 196-byte object, initializes it, copies the name, allocates an array of 148-byte sub-resource elements, runs conditional per-element validators (sub_546F30 / ConditionalCheckCall / sub_546F70), stores config a4 and a3, links the node via sub_547670 and returns 0.

operations.description: Look up an existing resource by name via sub_548890; when found and the a4 flag bit 0x100 is clear, increment its reference count at offset 136 and return 0 without allocating.
Allocate a 196-byte object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and initialize it through ConstructorInputControlInit.
Copy the identifier string a2 into the new object via SelfCopyStringToBuffer.
Build the sub-resource element count: read dword slot 41 (offset 164), increment it by one for the primary element and by one more when the suffix string a6 is present and non-empty.

Allocate an array of (148 * count) bytes plus a 4-byte count header via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; store the count at the header, initialize each 148-byte element with StructInitWithDefaults_fb90 in a loop, and store the element-array pointer into dword slot 42 (offset 168).

When the primary string a5 is non-empty, normalize it into the first sub-resource element via SelfRelativeCopyNormalize and run the primary validator sub_546F30; a nonzero result fails the function with -1.
When a5 is empty, run the fallback validator ConditionalCheckCall instead; a nonzero result fails the function with -1.

When the suffix string a6 is present and non-empty, normalize it into the second sub-resource element (first element + 148) via SelfRelativeCopyNormalize and run the suffix validator sub_546F70; a nonzero result fails the function with -1.
Store the config value a4 into the first sub-resource element at offset 64, then store a3 into dword slot 39 (offset 156).
Link the new resource node into the owning object via sub_547670, then OR the value 3 into the flags dword slot 39 (offset 156).
Return 0 on success, -1 when a validator reports failure, or 0 via the reuse path when an existing resource was found.
